name: Floors route → ESCALATE: not clean, budget exhausted → park toward the human
description:
The escalate route (design R1/SB5, group 5). When the attempt was NOT clean (route.not_clean=true) AND the iteration budget is exhausted (route.attempt.0 count ≥ 3, via length_gt 2), the dev loop cannot converge by rule. This PARKS the run toward the human: it records run.awaiting_human on the run and posts to the channel-agnostic user-response bus. No Go reconciler advances a run whose dev loop exhausted its budget (G2/B3/B7). This is the honest terminal of the bounded loop — an unconverged task NEVER passes verify or ships a hollow PR, it parks (the semspec disease inverted).

TRIGGER = the developer loop L_n: route.not_clean eq "true" (required:false) AND route.attempt.0 length_gt 2 (required:true — count ≥ 3) AND route.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). Mutually exclusive with retry (06c, length_lt 3): the two length conditions partition the count with no gap. length_gt 2 (not length_eq 3) is strictly FAIL-CLOSED — even if the +1-per-dispatch invariant were ever violated and the count over-shot, escalate still catches count > 3 and retry provably cannot fire, so a run can never retry past budget nor hang.

WRITER: run.awaiting_human's writer is the park-rule subsystem (G5) — one of the sanctioned park realizations (alongside run-lifecycle/03 ask_human, sandbox/02 unprovable, and the review-park 07c / delivery-park 08b). All mean the identical thing (this run awaits a human, here is why) and upsert the one park marker the whole system reads; they differ only in TRIGGER. Rule add_triple carries no Source, so the vocab keeps the single entry with no writer drift.

RUN BINDING: the park marker goes on the RUN (subject-override the developer loop L_n's agent.run.entity_id).

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps route.routed=$entity.instance on the developer loop L_n, guarded by route.routed length_eq 0. A LOOP-scoped guard (not run.awaiting_human) is required because this rule fires on the developer loop L_n, which does NOT carry the run-scoped park marker — a run-scoped guard would read absent on the loop and re-post to the user bus every rescan.

on_enter.subject: $entity.triple.agent.run.entity_id
on_enter.object: the dev loop exhausted its iteration budget without a clean attempt; the last attempt did not measure green or a structural floor rejected it

metadata.station: route escalate — not clean + budget exhausted → park (R1/SB5, group 5)
metadata.trigger_rationale: route.not_clean eq true AND route.attempt.0 length_gt 2 (count ≥ 3). Partitions the count with retry's length_lt 3; length_gt 2 is fail-closed (catches an over-count too).
metadata.writer_note: run.awaiting_human is written by the park-rule subsystem (G5) — a sanctioned park realization. Rule add_triple carries no Source, so the single vocab entry is not drifted.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped route.routed marker (not run.awaiting_human, which lives on the run and would never extinguish on the loop).
